description: This file defines a Perl package Git::IndexInfo that manages index information for git, including methods for creating a new object, removing an entry, updating an entry, and cleaning up resources.

classes.name: Git::IndexInfo
classes.description: A class representing git index information, providing methods to manipulate index entries.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Git::IndexInfo object, initializes index with config value and opens communication pipe.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entry from the index given its path by printing removal information to the index pipe.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or adds an index entry with mode, hash, and path information, printing to the index pipe.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that closes the communication pipe.
